location: Uptown, Central City, Broadmoor & the CBD
heroIntro: Get your boots on the ground with council member {councilName} and popular influencer {influencerName} on a three stop tour to experience the nightlife and support local businesses while building a relationship with your council member.
councilQuote: This isn't just about nightlife; it's about connecting with the community where they are. We're breaking down the walls of City Hall.
influencerQuote: District {district} has some of the most vibrant, unsung spots in the city. I can't wait to show everyone what makes this neighborhood tick.

stops.title: {influencerName}'s Sundown Wind Down
stops.body: The crawl begins at a spot {influencerName} calls essentialùlive energy, strong pours, and the kind of room that sets the tone for the whole night.

stops.title: {councilName}'s Mystery Pick
stops.body: Councilmember {councilName} takes the group to a trusted institution where regulars, workers, and visitors mixùperfect for talking policy without leaving the party behind.

stops.title: The District B Vote
stops.body: The final stop is yours. Vote now to send the crawl to the {location} venue you want on the map when we roll through on March 12.
